## Definition {#definition .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

An Access right determines if a user has the permission to execute one or multiple linked functionalities, such as the permission to flash a new application or to clear the device error memory.

## List of supported access rights {#list-of-supported-access-rights .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Access Right                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

| ECU Reset                         | Permission for restarting the device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                   | Enables or disables the following UDS-service: 0x11 (ECU Reset).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Communication Control             | Permission for managing the communication settings of the device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                   | Enables or disables the following UDS-service: 0x28 (Communication Control).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Control DTC Settings              | Permission to disable the logging of Diagnostic Trouble Codes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                   | Enables or disables the UDS service 0x85 (Control DTC Settings).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Clear DTC                         | Permission to clear one or multiple Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC\'s).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                   | Enables or disables the UDS service 0x14 (Clear Diagnostic Information).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Save changed DID\'s               | Permission to call the UDS \'saveParam\' routine, which writes back changed parameters to NVM.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                   | Linked to UDS service 0x31 (Routine Control).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Flash Control Block (CB)          | Permission to flash the CB.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                   | Enables the UDS services 0x35 (Request Upload), 0x34 (Request Download) and 0x36 (Transfer Data) and grants additional permissions.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Flash BSW + ASW                   | Permission to flash the application.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                   | Enables the UDS services 0x35 (Request Upload), 0x34 (Request Download) and 0x36 (Transfer Data) and grants additional permissions.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Change User Password              | Permission to change the password for all access levels.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                   | This Access Right enables the access to bds_sec_saveSecret. It is not directly linked to any UDS-service.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Custom Right 1 .. 32              | Additionally to the standard access rights, up to 32 custom access-rights can be added and configured in easyConfig. Custom access rights provide a way to manage the access to functions and features within the application itself. Custom access rights must not interfere with the given standard access rights. |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

[]{#fig_b5dccf .hmanchor}Table 1: Access rights specification
